start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:turn-a-correction-into-workflows with my correction: 'You wrote the reply in a hurry and never checked it against my saved replies, and you left the price out of every one.'"
no_lists_because: It keeps each fix as a workflow row in the workflow recipes and publishes it to the marketplace, not as rows of a list of the person's.
instructions: 1. Copy your correction exactly as you wrote or said it (at least 10 characters); do not tidy it, the steps quote your own words.
2. Say "Run workflow:turn-a-correction-into-workflows" with that correction as the correction input.

3. Step name splits it into each separate thing done wrong, quoting your words; step cause names the habit, missing instruction, missing check or missing tool behind each (a one-off slip is not a cause).
4. Step apply fixes the piece in front of you and every other part of the same work it touches, saying what changed and where.

5. Step keep searches the workflow recipes for one that already does that job and improves it (when it is yours), saves a variation naming where it came from (when it is someone else's) or saves a new one, and publishes it when nothing in it is private; read the workflow ids it hands back.

worked_examples.title: One correction is split into two things done wrong
worked_examples.ask: Here is my correction: you wrote the reply in a hurry and never checked it against my saved replies, and you left the price out of every one.
